noDocumentation.description: If true, do not include documentation.

noInherited.description:
If true, skip data fields and methods purely inherited from mixin types (not mentioned in the type declaration
itself).

noPrePostamble.description:
If true, skip outer structure and produce only the declaration itself (which may not be valid as a stand-alone
file).

mainDeclarationOnly.description:
If true, only generates the type declaration that represents a fully-instantiated instance, and skips other
potentially useful declarations for the type. For example, in {@link TypeScriptApiGenerator}, the type declaration
to be used for method parameter value type (the I* class) will be skipped if this flag is set true.

imports.description: Generate `import` statements for types referenced if the language requires them.

skipTypes.description:
If the caller already has some definitions generated and is using #addReferenced, specifying the types it already
has in this array will prevent them from being re-generated. This option is only effective with
{@link ApiGenerator#generateBatch}.

@see #addReferenced

exportInterfaceInsteadOfClass.description: If true and applicable for the language, export interface instead of exporting class.

title:
Options for API declaration generation. By default, anything that can be expressed is, but this allows some content
to be skipped for simpler results.
name: ApiGeneratorSpec
